what: human ratings for the blinded homograph listening package

scoring.quality_scale_caveat: Every clip received quality=3, so these ratings provide no quality ordering.

verdict: The engine selected the contextually correct reading for 36/40 clips. Four of 20 words failed one of their two contexts, consistent with a fixed-pronunciation failure on present, produce, bass, and record rather than a general inability to render heteronyms.
method: Rated through the listening page with shuffled opaque item IDs. CAPITAL letters indicated stressed syllables; glosses identified the intended meaning.
